nodes.title: Alder-type inequalities for fixed perimeter partitions

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the number of partitions of $n$ into odd parts in which each part occurs at most three times equals the number of partitions of $n$ into parts congruent to $1$ or $3$ modulo $4$ such that for no natural number $j \le n$ are both $4j + 1$ and $4j + 3$ parts.
nodes.title: Andrews–Lewis identity
Merca's identities for sums of different parts

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the number of partitions of $n$ into distinct parts any two of which differ by at least $2$ equals the number of polarized partitions of $n$, that is, partitions of $n$ into distinct parts in which every even part is greater than twice the number of odd parts.
nodes.title: Partitions with 2-distant parts and polarized partitions

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the number of partitions of $n$ into distinct parts, any two of which differ by at least $2$, equals the number of partitions of $n$ all of whose parts are congruent to $1$ or $4$ modulo $5$.
nodes.title: Rogers–Ramanujan identity (first form)
Stanley's and Elder's theorems on parts of partitions

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
